title: 彩虹是怎么来的
subtitle: 阳光和雨滴的七彩相遇
question: 彩虹是怎么来的？

moral.zh: 阳光进入雨滴时先折射，其中一部分光在雨滴内部反射，离开时再次折射；不同波长的光弯转角度不同，于是分开成彩色光，许多雨滴一起组成了彩虹。
moral.en: Sunlight refracts as it enters a raindrop. Some of that light reflects inside and refracts again as it leaves. Light of different wavelengths bends by different amounts, separating into colors that many raindrops combine into a rainbow.

pages.zh: 雨刚停，阳光从小树背后照过来，前方挂起一道彩虹。小树兴奋地问：“彩虹是怎么来的？”
pages.en: The rain had just stopped. With sunlight shining from behind Xiaoshu, a rainbow appeared ahead. “How is a rainbow made?” he asked excitedly.

pages.en: “Why does it have so many colors, and why is it curved like an arch?” Xiaoshu turned to check the Sun behind him, then looked back at the raindrops ahead.

pages.zh: 爸爸说：“阳光看起来是白色的，其实藏着许多颜色。阳光斜着进入圆圆的雨滴时，会先折弯一次，这叫折射。”
pages.en: Papa said, “Sunlight looks white, but it contains many colors. When it enters a round raindrop at an angle, it bends once. This is called refraction.”

pages.zh: “看彩虹时，太阳要在身后，雨滴要在前方。能把彩色光送进眼睛的雨滴围成一个大圆，地面常挡住下半圈，所以我们多半看到弯弯的彩虹。”
pages.en: “To see a rainbow, the Sun must be behind us and raindrops ahead. The drops sending colored light to our eyes lie around a big circle. The ground usually hides its lower part, so we mostly see an arc.”
